{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv'
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", raw_data['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Check group sizes by species to assess balance
print("\nGroup sizes by species:")
print(raw_data['species'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = raw_data.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm']).groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print results
print("\nMean flipper length by species (after dropping missing flipper_length_mm):")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
